SessionStart.command: out=$(nh doc-check 2>&1) || { echo 'nh doc-check found problems:'; echo "$out"; }

PreToolUse.command: if grep -Eq 'git +(commit|push)'; then echo 'Commits and pushes are mine to make. Suggest the command instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi

Stop.command: if ! out=$(pnpm -s test 2>&1); then echo 'The tests fail:' >&2; echo "$out" | tail -n 40 >&2; exit 2; fi
